魏.english: surname Wei; name of a vassal state of the Zhou dynasty from 661 BC in Shanxi, one of the Seven Hero Warring States; Wei state, founded by Cao Cao 曹操[Cao2 Cao1], one of the Three Kingdoms after the Han dynasty; the Wei dynasty 221–265; Wei Prefecture or Wei County at various times in history; tower over a palace gateway (old)

一.english: one; single; a (article); as soon as; entire; whole; all; throughout; "one" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 1); also pr. [yao1] for greater clarity when spelling out numbers digit by digit

花.english: surname Hua; flower; blossom; CL:朵[duo3],支[zhi1],束[shu4],把[ba3],盆[pen2],簇[cu4]; fancy pattern; florid; to spend (money, time); (coll.) lecherous; lustful

次.english: next in sequence; second; the second (day, time etc); secondary; vice-; sub-; infra-; inferior quality; substandard; order; sequence; hypo- (chemistry); classifier for enumerated events: time

百.english: surname Bai; hundred; numerous; all kinds of

船.english: boat; vessel; ship; CL:條|条[tiao2],艘[sou1],隻|只[zhi1]

最.english: (before an adjective or verb) to the highest degree; (the) most ...; -est; (after 之[zhi1]) best or most extreme example (e.g. 世界之最[shi4 jie4 zhi1 zui4] "the greatest in the world")

三月.english: March; third month (of the lunar year)

北國.english: the northern part of the country; the North

東西.english: east and west; thing; stuff; person; CL:個|个[ge4],件[jian4]

發出.english: to issue (an order, decree etc); to send out; to dispatch; to produce (a sound); to let out (a laugh)

可以.english: can; may; possible; able to; not bad; pretty good

只能.english: can only; obliged to do sth; to have no other choice

過去.english: (in the) past; former; previous; to go over; to pass by; (verb suffix)

一塊.english: a piece; a chunk; (fig.) (coll.) (typically preceded by a specifier such as 這|这[zhe4]) aspect; area; dimension (Example: 情感這一塊|情感这一块[qing2 gan3 zhe4 yi1 kuai4] "the emotional aspect (of it)"); (coll.) one yuan; a dollar; together; in the same place; in company

看看.english: to take a look at; to examine; to survey; (coll.) pretty soon

一點.english: a bit; a little bit; (used in negative expressions) (not) the least bit; (after an adjective, used to form the comparative) a bit more, -er; a point (in a discussion etc); (calligraphy) dot stroke (、); one o'clock (abbr. for 一點鍾|一点钟[yi1 dian3 zhong1])

入門.english: entrance door; to enter a door; to learn the basics of a subject; introduction (to a subject); (attributive) entry-level

一個.english: a; an; one; the whole (afternoon, summer vacation etc)

一次.english: first; first time; once; (math.) linear (of degree one)

就是.english: exactly; precisely; only; simply; just; (used correlatively with 也[ye3]) even; even if

這樣.english: this way; like this; so; (before a noun) this kind of; such

出來.english: to come out; to appear; to arise; (after a verb, indicates coming out, completion of an action, or ability to discern or detect)

帶大.english: (coll.) to raise (a child or animal) to adulthood; to bring up

老街.english: Lao Cai, Vietnam; Laokai or Laukkai, Burma (Myanmar); old street

多少.english: number; amount; somewhat; how much?; how many?; (phone number, student ID etc) what number?

張北.english: see 張北縣|张北县[Zhang1 bei3 Xian4]

一下.english: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try); all at once; suddenly
